support.delete.answer.zh-Hans: 聊天在历史列表中删除，记忆在“设置 → Agent 记忆与技能”中另行清除。清除记忆后，请停止生成并新建对话。已下载模型可在模型列表删除，内置模型可能无法单独删除。这些操作不会清理已分享的副本、剪贴板、备份或第三方记录。
support.delete.answer.en: Delete chats in History, and clear memory separately in Settings → Agent Memory and Skills. After clearing memory, stop generation and start a new chat. Downloaded models can be removed in the model list; bundled models may not be individually removable. Shared copies, clipboard contents, backups and third-party records are not cleared by these actions.

support.delete.question.en: How do I remove local data?

support.download.answer.zh-Hans: 模型负责在本机生成回答。可以直接使用已安装的模型，也可以从模型列表下载其他模型。下载前请查看大小和剩余空间，大文件建议使用 Wi-Fi。
support.download.answer.en: The model generates answers on your device. You can use an installed model or download another from the model list. Check its size and available storage first; Wi-Fi is recommended for large downloads.

support.offline.answer.zh-Hans: 可以。已安装的模型支持普通离线聊天。模型目录、下载、Agent 搜索和网页读取需要联网，部分页面也会尝试刷新目录。
support.offline.answer.en: Yes. Ordinary chat works offline with a supported model installed. Catalogs, downloads, Agent searches and webpages need a connection; some screens may still try to refresh the catalog.

support.reportPrivacy.zh-Hans: 发送内容包含问题描述、App 版本和 iOS 版本，不会自动附上聊天。
support.reportPrivacy.en: Includes your description, app version and iOS version. Chats are not attached automatically.

support.slow.answer.zh-Hans: 长对话、大模型和思考模式需要更多计算。可以停止回答、开启新对话或尝试更小的模型。设备发热时可稍后再继续使用。
support.slow.answer.en: Long conversations, larger models, and thinking mode need more work. Stop the response, start a new chat, or try a smaller model. If the device is hot, let it cool before continuing.

support.contact.detail.zh-Hans: 使用问题、建议、隐私请求或内容投诉，都可以发到这个邮箱。请尽量说明操作步骤和模型名称，我们会核实并回复。截图请先遮挡个人信息，不要发送密码或验证码。
support.contact.detail.en: Send questions, suggestions, privacy requests or content reports to this address. Include the steps and model name if relevant; we will investigate and reply. Redact personal information in screenshots and never send passwords or verification codes.

support.cloud.question.zh-Hans: 聊天会发给云端大模型吗？
support.cloud.question.en: Are chats sent to a cloud AI model?

support.cloud.answer.zh-Hans: 普通对话在本机生成。Agent 联网时，可能把您的问题或根据上下文、记忆生成的搜索词发给搜索服务。反馈和分享也会发送您选择的内容。
support.cloud.answer.en: Ordinary chat runs locally. Agent can send search queries based on your question, context or memory to search providers. Feedback and sharing also send the content you choose.

support.fees.zh-Hans: 当前版本免费，无订阅或应用内购买。
support.fees.en: Free to use. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.
